$comment: Training config scaffold for the owned regulatory embedder/reranker. Consumed by the out-of-band training harness (not CI). See scripts/ml/README.md.

model.name: c2c-regulatory-embedder
model.note: Pick a base whose output dimension matches the target corpus in server/services/embedding-corpus-policy.ts, or project to it. 1536d corpora → use a 1536d base or add a projection head; 3072d corpora → text-embedding-3-large-class base.

eval.acceptance: must beat OpenAI text-embedding-3-small/large baseline on retrieval hit-rate and faithfulness before promotion
